allowedLanguages.title: Allowed languages
allowedLanguages.description: Language codes such as en, fr, ar or pt-BR. Empty = any language.

defaultLanguage.title: Default language
defaultLanguage.description: The language of answers when a message shows none, for example en. Empty = the first allowed language, else English.

markerWords.title: Marker words
markerWords.description: One line per language, for example `tl: po salamat ako "wala po"` (quoted words count only together). Words in Latin letters under a language written in another script mark that language in Latin letters (<code>-Latn).

minMarkers.title: Marker words that pick a language

markerShare.title: Or this share of the message's words
markerShare.description: For example 0.15, counted from the number of words below. 0 = off: then one marker word is enough in a message of up to 3 words.

minWordsForShare.title: Words a message needs for the share

strict.title: Strict check
strict.description: With the Whole check: a reply must also match the visitor’s language by its share of marker words.

checkMode.title: How replies are checked
checkMode.description: Whole: the whole answer must be in the visitor's language. Presence: each part of the answer needs one marker word of the language (or a letter of its script); a language without marker words fails with as many marker words of another language as pick it, or with letters of another script.

acceptLatinFor.title: Also accept in Latin letters
acceptLatinFor.description: Languages written in another script whose replies may also be in Latin letters, and the reverse, for example hi. Latin replies are checked with the marker words of <code>-Latn.

unavailableTexts.title: The unavailable message in other languages
unavailableTexts.description: Sent instead of the unavailable text to a visitor writing that language, one line per language, for example `es: Lo siento, ahora no puedo responder.`
